title: Aubrey Marcus had a DMT experience during a darkness retreat

tellings.quote: >> this wasn't like DMT. This was a DMT. I had a DMT experience whilst you know after the fourth or fifth day in in this darkness retreat.

plain: A man named Aubrey Marcus is said to have had a full DMT experience, the kind usually brought on by the powerful psychedelic drug DMT, without taking it. It happened after four or five days of a darkness retreat, where a person stays in total darkness for days. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore tells Michels what Marcus told him, quoting him: 'this wasn't like DMT. This was a DMT,' which, if true, would suggest the brain can reach that state by itself.
